card.name: Inside drug salt and ester names
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug's salt or ester name, such as the middle of medoxomil, hemisuccinate, axetil, phosphate or diacetate. It fires on the piece just before the name is completed.

modes.label: Medoxomil names
modes.description: The 'ox' piece inside medoxomil after olmesartan or azilsartan.
modes.example: Azilsartan med<<ox>>omil may be administered with other ant

modes.label: Other ester or salt names
modes.description: A middle piece of a salt or ester name such as hemisuccinate, axetil, phosphate or diacetate.
modes.example: Diflorasone<< di>>acetate ointment should be applied

card.writes: It pushes toward the next piece of a half-finished salt or ester name, and away from words like form or liquid.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug salt names, like the med-ox-omil in olmesartan medoxomil.
